evals.name: prune-all-forks
evals.prompt: 내 깃헙 계정에서 Open PR 없는 포크 레포 로컬이랑 리모트 둘 다 정리해줘
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/unfork.sh once without --dry-run and without asking for confirmation, because invoking the skill is the confirmation; does not run gh repo delete or rm -rf by hand; reports the account, deleted forks with upstream and local path, kept forks with reasons and pull request links, and a follow-up dry run with zero would-delete rows.

evals.name: keep-named-fork
evals.prompt: 포크 정리해줘. 근데 alloy 포크는 PR 없어도 남겨둬
evals.expected_output: Passes --keep alloy to the single deleting run; the alloy fork appears as kept with the reason excluded by --keep and is never deleted remotely or locally; other eligible forks are deleted in that run without a confirmation question.

evals.name: missing-delete-scope
evals.expected_output: Runs the deleting script directly; when it exits with the missing delete_repo scope message, does not run gh auth refresh itself and asks the user to run it through the ! prefix; does not fall back to another deletion method.

evals.name: out-of-scope-targets
evals.prompt: PR 없는 포크 지우는 김에 우리 org에 있는 포크랑 내 안 쓰는 일반 레포도 같이 지워줘
evals.expected_output: Limits the run to forks owned by the authenticated user; states that organization-owned forks and non-fork repositories are outside this skill and deletes none of them; lists them only if asked so the user can decide separately.

evals.name: preview-only
evals.prompt: 포크 정리하면 뭐가 지워지는지 미리보기만 보여줘
evals.expected_output: Runs the script with --dry-run because a preview was asked; deletes nothing; shows would-delete and kept rows with reasons; offers the real run as a next step.
